name: Greyport Wall
description: Their goalie covers more net and reacts sooner.
trick: Shields: their goalie stops the first three shots on goal of every period, whatever they are. Burn them with quick shots.
club: A harbour club built around one goalie. The skaters change every year; the result does not.

name: Coldwater Gale
trick: Fast break: whoever of theirs wins the puck in their own end gets a burst of speed. Keep it out of their end.
club: A college-town club of prodigies. Every one of them will be gone to a bigger league by spring.

name: Ironvale Hammers
description: Their checks land far more often.
trick: Flatteners: every body check of theirs that lands puts you on the ice. Deke, or move the puck early.
club: The foundry's company team. Half of them have worked the night shift before the puck drops.

name: Highmoor Marathon
trick: Full press: all three come after you in your own end. Pass through them.
club: Old-timers who will not retire. They have been skating the same shifts for twenty years and never seem to tire.

name: Redcliff Marksmen
trick: The marksman: their best shooter's fully wound-up shot cannot be saved. Check him before he lets go.
club: A club with deep pockets and one bought star. Everything they do ends on his stick.

name: Frostgate Trappers
description: Faster passes, and they are hard to take the puck from.
trick: Threaded passes: their flat passes cannot be picked off in the lane. Cover the man in front of your net, not the pass.
club: A patient northern club that has run the same system for thirty years and sees no reason to change.

name: Saltmarsh Shadows
description: Hard to check off the puck.
trick: Spin move: the first check that would strip each of them fails, and it comes back every 12 seconds. Check twice, or poke first to burn it.
club: Nobody can say who their best player is. Nobody can catch any of them to find out.

name: Cinder Peak Furnace
trick: Hot start: they are on fire from the opening faceoff of every period. Hold the puck and block shots until it burns out.
club: The dynasty: five banners, a full barn, and a habit of ending games in the first ten minutes.

name: Quarry Hill Granite
description: They cannot be knocked off their feet.
trick: Granite: a body check never puts one of them down, and they shake it off in half the time. Poke the puck away and leave the hitting alone.
club: The quarry's company team. Every man on it lifts stone for a living and skates like it.

name: Lantern Bay Night Shift
description: They get stronger as the game gets late.
trick: Night shift: in the last period and in overtime they skate faster, shoot harder and barely tire. Be ahead before it starts, and spend your powerups early.
club: A cannery town where half the roster comes straight from work. They are never awake for the first period and never beaten in the third.

name: Maple Grove Carnival
description: Their mascot always plays the first period.
trick: Carnival: their mascot always takes the ice for the first period, and he can play. Keep it close until the horn, when he goes back to the stands.
club: A fairground town whose club is half hockey team, half travelling show. The crowd comes for the mascot and stays for the hockey.

name: Harrow Ridge Pickets
description: Their skaters block shots without going down.
trick: Pickets: any of them standing off the puck stops a shot that passes close to him. Fake the shot to move them, or pass across and shoot first-touch from the side.
club: A farm-country club that has never had a scorer and has never needed one. They stand in front of everything.
